instruction.text: Angie orders a new jumper on the internet. The delivery estimate is 72 hours. How many days is that?
David is going on a skiing holiday for 9 days. How many hours are in 9 days?
Will’s personal best for the 1000 m is 220 seconds. How many minutes is that?
instruction.sound: Will’s personal best for the one thousand meters is 220 seconds. How many minutes is that?

instruction.text: Rebecca is poorly and needs to take medicine every 4 hours. One pack of medicine contains 42 pills. How many days will they last?

atoms.a: First, divide the hours in a day by the number of times Rebecca has to take her medicine.
Next, divide the total number of pills by your answer.

instruction.text: The Christmas holidays at Gemma’s school are from the 18th December to the 7th January, including those days. How many days is that?
The school day at St Mark’s begins at 8:30 and ends at 15:30. How long is the school day?

atoms.a: On Fridays, school finishes earlier at 15:00. What is the time difference between the length of the day on Fridays and on other days in minutes?
